$comment: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/qa/state-coverage.ts. ignore: not a state a route must reach (key = <Board>, <Board>.<prop> or <Board>.<value>). demoOnly: the state is proven on a demo route (/dev/ui/...) and the reason says why real data is not needed or not possible yet. Persona S 'banner' and the real 401/429 paths are @state (phase-01 plan §12.3); everything else in P1 is @demo with a reason here.

ignore.V3FlowMap: Reference board: the route map and navigation graph. It has no route (allocation.md row 284).

demoOnly.V3Nav.home: Home is built in P5; P1 shows the destination on /dev/ui/shell?current=home only.
demoOnly.V3Nav.play: Real /play is covered by shell.spec.ts; the board state is the sidebar with Play current, shown on /dev/ui/shell?current=play.
demoOnly.V3Nav.train: Train is built in P5; /dev/ui/shell renders the destination.
demoOnly.V3Nav.learn: Learn is built in P8; /dev/ui/shell renders the destination.
demoOnly.V3Nav.review: Review is built in P3; /dev/ui/shell renders the destination.
demoOnly.V3Nav.profile: Profile v3 is built in P10; the legacy /profile keeps its own chrome in P1.
demoOnly.V3Nav.settings: Settings is built in P10; /dev/ui/shell renders the destination.
demoOnly.V3CommandPalette.open: The palette is a shell overlay; its content does not depend on account data (shell.spec.ts covers it on /play too).
demoOnly.V3CommandPalette.ask: Ask mode lights up in P7 (AI coach); P1 shows the disabled entry on /dev/ui/shell.
demoOnly.V3CommandPalette.closed: Closed is the shell's resting state; no data involved.
demoOnly.V3iPhoneToasts.default: Toast placement above the iPhone action bar, on /dev/ui/sections/overlays at iPhone size.
demoOnly.V3iPadPToasts.default: Toast placement on iPad portrait, on /dev/ui/sections/overlays at iPad size.
demoOnly.V3PaymentFailed.last_day: Needs a past_due period ending within 36 h; /dev/ui/shell?user=payment_last_day (persona payment_last_day exists for manual checks).
demoOnly.V3PaymentFailed.expired: Needs an on_hold period that ended; /dev/ui/shell?user=payment_expired (persona payment_expired exists for manual checks).
demoOnly.V3Skeletons.game: Loading skeletons are transient; /dev/ui/skeletons?variant=game holds them still.
demoOnly.V3EmptyStates.default: Pattern specimen on /dev/ui/sections/controls; real empty states arrive with each phase's lists.
demoOnly.V3SessionExpired.signing_in: Transient state between 'Sign In Again' and Clerk's page; /dev/ui/data holds it.
demoOnly.V3SessionExpired.in_game_refresh: In-game silent refresh is built in P2 with the live game.
demoOnly.V3SessionExpired.in_game_ok: In-game silent refresh is built in P2 with the live game.
